Channel Swimmer Tow.name: Channel Swimmer Tow
Channel Swimmer Tow.description: The user swims up to twenty meters this turn and loops their tongue around one conscious person's torso, keeping their face clear while towing them toward a bank or ladder. The person must remain within the tongue's twenty-meter reach. Strong currents, submerged snags and the user's held breath limit the tow; an unconscious person's airway needs direct support. Strain: moderate.
